payload.text: A remit set with `intent wb remit <moniker> "<text>"` is the project's own: it survives every later apply and re-renders the roster README, and `intent wb remit <moniker> --default` removes it. A seat with none shows its profile's default wherever a remit is shown, read from the installed profile, marked as the default and never written to the row, and the dry run names each such seat.
